row.title: The seed carries its own definition, generated from its code
row.body: Found: seed/ had 72 standing rules and no single definition of what an Ultrastable system is, how it runs, bootstraps and reaches criticality; its instructions cited about 40 python3 -m foundation commands that a seeded system does not have, and checks.yml never ran seed/tests. Built seed/SYSTEM.md, generated by seed/scripts/system.py from seed/autonomy/system.json and the code of record, loaded first by CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md; seed/tests/test_system.py passes (7) and the seed suite passes (82). 16 rules remain enforced only by the platform: not_in_kit, shrink-only, one Q-KIT item each. SYSTEM-SPEC-1.
